prompt: Our Qdrant cluster RAM keeps growing even though we stopped ingesting data a week ago. We're getting alerts at 80% memory (3.24GB of 4GB). When we restart the cluster, memory drops back down immediately. Is this a memory leak?

assertions.text: Distinguishes between DATA memory (80% = danger) and TOTAL memory including cache (80% = often fine)
Does NOT dismiss the issue as 'just cache' - acknowledges 1-12MB/day slow growth as a known issue pattern
Recommends checking collection count as a diagnostic step (12-14MB overhead per collection)
Recommends upgrading to latest Qdrant version
Recommends checking Qdrant metrics endpoint to separate data from cache
Does NOT treat restart as bad practice - acknowledges it as a valid operational tool
